exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
cohort: Women with a single live fetus in cephalic presentation with one previous low-transverse cesarean delivery who underwent trial of labor after cesarean delivery at ≥37 gestational weeks between January 2011 and December 2015
finding: The prediction model for successful VBAC based on variables easily obtainable at the first antenatal visit had an AUC of 0.70, indicating moderate accuracy.
mod_finding: The study aimed to validate a prediction model for successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC).
